Name: Uxi's cute anime style portraits
Author: Uxi9876
Description:
Hello everyone, this is the portrait mod I've created for Stardew Valley, featuring 12 characters available for dating along with some villagers.
I'm not very skilled at drawing male characters; I excel more in drawing females and children.
If you like my male character drawings, I might consider adding more in the future.
(I'll be portraying everyone as adults/teenagers since I struggle with drawing older characters TT)
[b]
[color=#ff0000]Instructions for use:
[/color][/b]XNB version:
Simply replace the files in Stardew Valley\Content\Portraits.
Make sure to back up your files properly.

CP Version:
drag the file in Mods file.

(JayNM helped me with it, Thank you!)

大家好！这是我绘制的包含12位可结婚角色和一些村民的角色美化头像。
我不太会画男性所以基本画的都是女孩子和小孩，
不过如果有人喜欢我画的男性的话我会考虑把其他男性角色补上！
（因为画风原因我会把老年人都画成青年或者少年（不好意思））
[b]
[color=#ff0000]如何使用：
[/color][/b]XNB格式：
替换Stardew Valley\Content\Portraits的文件。
请记得备份你原本的文件！

CP格式（不用替换源文件的）：
放进Mods文件夹。

（谢谢帮我制作CP格式的JayNM！）
